title: TeamTalk Music Player v2.1.8
changelog: Fixed non-repeating shuffle mode: tracks are never replayed until the queue finishes
Added automatic volume normalization (EBU R128) via 'nz' command (default: off)
Optimized 'resette' command using native Win32 Registry APIs without PowerShell
Added unknown command response for private messages
Improved asynchronous yt-dlp updater with concurrency protection
Added convenient command aliases: sp/speed, mode, and shuffle
